test: C01 different activities preserve both contextual accounts
note: Explicit reading/dancing domains are separate; both source references remain. Behavioral planning benefit is unmeasured.

test: C02 half-open adjacent periods are separate and unknown endpoints stay unknown
note: Adjacent half-open periods are disjoint; unknown endpoints and explicit unbounded endpoints differ.

test: C03 opposing attendance accounts conflict over one declared occasion
note: Both source references are returned and the finite attendance domain exhausts without a witness.

test: C04 matching labels cannot resolve an unknown subject identity
note: A null reviewed identity stays unknown despite agreeing values. No identity extractor is included.

test: C05 different recording machines do not change applicability
note: Recording origin is ignored by semantic compatibility, preserving the same conflict.

test: C06 unspecified applicability differs from explicitly unrestricted
note: Missing activity yields unknown; supplied unrestricted activity overlaps reading.

test: C07 pairwise witnesses do not imply a joint witness
note: All three constraint pairs have witnesses, but the full triangle exhausts eight assignments. An ordinary exhaustive checker implements the same mathematics.

test: C08 unary constraints report compatible domain narrowing
note: Returns witness A=0 and unary-domain narrowing. It does not claim complete relational projection from one witness.

test: C09 consistency of wrong annotations does not establish semantic truth
note: Deliberately wrong, mutually consistent attendance annotations pass formal checking and disagree with an independent fixture truth value; semantic extraction remains unevaluated.

test: C10 capped enumeration is unknown until the late witness is reached
note: Eight attempts yield unknown; all-ones is witnessed on attempt 256. Capped search never reports conflict.

test: C11 unavailable ineligible and stale sources block comparison
note: Three current-state variants produce explicit reasons and no joint verdict from invalid source annotations.

test: C12 different observers retain their attributed feelings
note: Known distinct observers separate personal feelings under an explicitly observer-relative reviewed property.

test: C13 unrelated groups retain independent compatibility verdicts
note: A conflicting attendance group and compatible independent group retain separate verdicts.

test: C14 an unaligned account cannot poison a known comparison
note: An unaligned unknown account gets its own report while the known group's exact joint result remains unchanged.

test: C15 reviewed overlap regions prevent transitive-overlap conflicts
note: Explicit local regions produce values 0 and 1 separately; all three time domains have no shared region. No transitive clustering is performed.
